Relay token check

Every token compiled from tokens/src/ by npm run tokens, shown with the compiled CSS. Use the switch to see each theme. Approved 2026-11-20 (foundations-approved). Kept up to date by every compile.

Radius

none 0px

Table cells, full-bleed panes, anything that butts against another edge.

xs 5px

Status chips (scaled, not pills), tags, keyboard-key hints.

sm 6px

Checkboxes, small inline controls, items inside menus and lists.

md 8px

Buttons, inputs, selects, the combobox, segmented controls: the control radius from the direction.

lg 12px

Panels, tables, cards, banners on the page.

xl 14px

The featured surface and floating layers (menus, popovers, comboboxes, tooltips, toasts, dialogs): the largest level.

full 9999px

Status dots and avatars only. Never buttons or chips.

Shadows

By role. In dark, the same layers at higher opacity; raised and floating surfaces also step lighter.

shadow-control

Primary buttons only: a slight lift so the main action feels pressable. One light source from above; color neutral 950 (#111014) at low opacity. Values from the approved composition (specimen tool).

shadow-raised

Panels and tables on the page: the direction separates panels by shadow. Soft, two layers. One light source from above; color neutral 950 (#111014) at low opacity. Values from the approved composition (specimen tool).

shadow-featured

The featured surface (the job that needs action): lifts much further than a panel. One light source from above; color neutral 950 (#111014) at low opacity. Values from the approved composition (specimen tool).

shadow-overlay

Floating layers: menus, popovers, comboboxes, tooltips, toasts, dialogs (dialogs add the scrim). The 1px layer gives the edge on white without a border. One light source from above; color neutral 950 (#111014) at low opacity. Values from the approved composition (specimen tool).
